substitutions.music: Music 2.6 production is retired. The package uses five hash-locked CC BY 4.0 tracks; official OST remains external-only.
substitutions.portraitMotion: Invalid sprite strips are retired. Static portraits are paired with 24 reachable dual-profile AU videos and reduced-motion fallbacks.

knownLimitations.officialOst: Free streaming is not a redistribution license, so ProjectMoon, Mili, and Studio EIM recordings are not bundled.
knownLimitations.canonDialogue: Canon scenes are sourced Chinese paraphrases, not a verbatim transcript or a replacement for the source game.
knownLimitations.finalTag: v2.0.0 remains reserved until complete-edition requirements and public CDN verification are satisfied.
